candidate_dispositions.reason_detail: Exact-revision inspection confirmed canonical invoice bytes, hashes, signatures, ZATCA verdicts and stamped XML, but no ZATCA XML/Data-Dictionary/Security version or digest, SDK/validator identity, authority receipt or effective interval. The emitted reporting:1.0 ProfileID is not the official ruleset version.

repository_profile.profile_source: This non-search artifact verification reused the pinned prior candidate and did not re-query repository popularity metadata.

best_result: Confirmed a precise CAP-008 control gap: deterministic invoice replay and ZATCA acceptance do not identify the exact official rule/specification bundle. Proposed an immutable internal authority receipt binding official artifact digests, effective interval, validator identity, renderer revision, invoice hash and external-response hash.
